releaseComment:
Update SQLite directly from 3.54.0 to 3.54.1, fixing a possible heap-buffer overflow in 32-bit builds and other issues reported in 3.54.0.

BREAKING CHANGE: SQLite-Vector 1.1.2 replaces sqlite-vec as the vector engine. Existing sqlite-vec SQL queries are incompatible and must be rewritten using SQLite-Vector APIs. Review the updated Usage guide before upgrading.
